description: This file implements the RunC container management class and related functionalities, including container creation, execution, state retrieval, and deletion, using the runc runtime. It defines classes for container info, configuration, and the runner that interfaces with the runc executable, along with container administrator and container classes.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a container using the runc CLI, including creating, executing commands, deleting, and retrieving state.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container's runtime state, including PID and status.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including process environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variables for the container process.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the host and adds them to the container's options.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.
